must_not_edit: app/pages/groups.tsx group profileMap (different semantics: no npub fallback, nickname-gated)

behaviour: C1: the self entry is nickname = ownProfile.nickname || truncateNpub(pubkeyToNpub(self)), avatar = ownProfile.avatar, updatedAt = build-time ISO timestamp, as on both pages before.

C2: the peer entry keeps each page's values: contacts uses contact.nickname || truncated npub, contact.avatar and contact.updatedAt ?? contact.lastSeenAt; feedback uses MAINTAINER_DISPLAY_NAME, avatar null and build time.
C3: no duplicated self-profile literal remains; both DM surfaces call the one helper.
C4: ContactChat's four feedback send-path gates (marker tags, onReact, allowImageAttachments with its paste/drop guards, allowMessageActions) stay separate, explicit checks; no FeedbackChat wrapper.
non_goals: Folding groups.tsx's own-profile overlay into the helper.
Merging the feedback gates or introducing a FeedbackChat wrapper.
deviations_from_finding: ContactChat now has four feedback gates, not three: allowMessageActions was added by the block-contact epic after the finding was filed. All four stay separate.
On the feedback page, self and peer updatedAt share one build-time timestamp; before, they came from two new Date() calls less than a millisecond apart.
